title: de and és — But and And

sections.title: Joining two ideas
sections.content: *de* ('but') and *és* ('and') connect two words or clauses in a sentence. *és* simply adds one idea to another; *de* contrasts them. They normally sit between the two parts.
Swap *de* for *és* and the meaning flips from contrast to addition — *Kicsi, de erős* (small, but strong) vs *Kicsi és erős* (small and strong): same words, opposite relationship.
